description: Create an Account/Subscription/Invoice/Payment/Product object with the given fields. Requires type and a non-empty fields object. This is a write action. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the object being created; the new object id is delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: Create a new Zuora billing object (e.g. a new Account or Subscription) with the supplied field values. Requires type (Account, Subscription, Invoice, Payment, Product) and a non-empty fields object. Dispatches asynchronously: a job_id comes back at once, the new object id lands moments later.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT confirmation the object exists -- id and success arrive separately, as their own message, when the job completes.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the create was queued -- do not present job_id/status as proof the object exists. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the confirmation lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, confirm creation and report the new object id; low sensitivity (id only, data_sensitivity 0.0).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params: missing/unsupported type or an empty/missing fields object. zuora.validation_failed: a field value or combination was rejected. zuora.auth_failed: the OAuth client credentials were rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: zuora.validation_failed: check required fields and valid values for that object type. zuora.invalid_params: type must be one of Account, Subscription, Invoice, Payment, Product.
